_comment: Routers that server.js requires but never mounts. Every request to the
endpoints in these files 404s, so each entry is a feature that is present
in the tree and unreachable over HTTP.
They are allowlisted rather than mounted because mounting a router changes
the public API surface and each of these needs its own review of the auth
guards and payload validation on its routes. That work does not belong in
a fix whose job is to make server.js parse.
The list is a ceiling, not a target: scripts/check-server-wiring.js fails
on any router required and left unmounted that is not named here, so no
new one can be added. Remove entries as the routers are reviewed and
